description: Return STATUS HOUSE to the house feature, reject unrelated objects, and print completed expedition boxes with parser-supported names

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE V-EXPEDITION-STATUS ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,WHITE-HOUSE>
           <V-HOUSE-RISK-STATUS>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<NOT <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,EXPEDITION-ARCHIVE-INDEX>>
           <TELL "Only the completed expedition index has an archive status." CR>
           <SETG CLOCK-WAIT T>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <EXPEDITION-ENSURE>

replacements.old: (LDESC "A first completed-expedition banker box waits beneath the chronology shelf.")
replacements.new: (LDESC "A first completed expedition box waits beneath the chronology shelf.")

replacements.old: (LDESC "A second completed-expedition banker box remains physically separate from the first.")
replacements.new: (LDESC "A second completed expedition box remains physically separate from the first.")
